name: app-black-smart-home-notes-app-flow-with-side-captions
title: Black Smart-Home Notes App Flow
whatItIs: A black page of three phones stepping down the page (choose a room, write a note on a lilac card, set priority) with thin lines to tiny captions and round quote icons.
whatItMeans: The staggered phones and hairline captions tell a story on black, and lilac and yellow notes feel playful.
techniques: Room photo as a tappable canvas
Organic lilac note card with a tail
Round icon chips as decorative repeats

vocabulary.definition: Items alternating left and right down the page.
A thin line linking an image to its caption.
A coloured card representing a user note.
